## Hosted CI evidence, not a local reproduction

At default HEAD `c75260050298de1d287957d1e57d05fb1859ff34`, [macOS release gate job 125474280178](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rust/actions/runs/41502788789/job/125474280178) failed on 2026-11-02 at 20:18 UTC. The same HEAD remains current and this gate remains failed at 20:32 UTC; Linux, Bun and Windows aggregate jobs succeeded.

`tests/query_cost_contract.rs:138:9`, test `cli_json_toon_refusals_and_zero_writes`, reports:
```text
assertion `left == right` failed: disconnected consumers must refuse delivery
  left: Some(0)
 right: Some(2)
```
The query-cost contract binary finished with one passed and one failed test; `just release-check` exited 101. This is not evidence that every preceding/following release check passed, nor proof of a shipped artifact regression.

## Intended guarantee and impact
[Canonical pm-rust-query-cost](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rust/blob/c75260050298de1d287957d1e57d05fb1859ff34/.agents/pm/features/pm-rust-query-cost.toon), delivered by [PR #117](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rust/pull/117), explicitly records actual CLI closed-pipe checks for JSON and TOON to prove disconnected-consumer refusal. The current macOS aggregate cannot establish that guarantee and blocks its release gate.

## Investigation / acceptance criteria
- Reproduce the exact macOS command/environment from the linked job, including repeated JSON and TOON closed-pipe cases.
- Establish whether this is a subprocess/pipe synchronization flaw in the test or a real delivery-refusal defect; the hosted log alone does **not** distinguish these.
- Preserve a working-consumer success control and zero tracker/history writes. If the consumer is verified disconnected before delivery, verify the intended typed refusal/exit contract rather than silently succeeding.
- Add deterministic regression coverage for the established cause and pass the unchanged aggregate gates; do not lower coverage/safety thresholds to make this green.

Dedup checked all-status repository issues/PRs, current discussions and canonical PM records. No runtime source was executed locally and no provider or production state was changed.
macOS release gate: disconnected-consumer query-cost check returned success
